item.content:encoded:
Yeah, it was a fine Tale. Nothing else to say, I just liked to see these other Nobodies, their encounters with White Suit (may their shins rest in peace) and just how they live their lives.

+1.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I liked it! HarryBlank managed to sum up my thoughts pretty well.

I love the small bit that Nobody just loves waffles, and seeing the different personalities progress through the years along with the Man in White was delightful. If I had one complaint, it is that this entry doesn't actually do anything - I doubt I will see these characters again, so the characterisation is somewhat… wasted? I'm uncertain what the word is there. I haven't really learned all that much at the conclusion of this, but I had a good time reading it and I'm happy to give it a +1.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: I love these patchwork document fragments sort of story, ever since I read Swan Song: 1945 which made me enchanted with this whole style of storytelling. The setting and context was instantly familiar to me and I was hooked. I’m looking forward to seeing everything else from the time.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: All three of these tales have just oozed charm, character, and detail. I never read this canon, but I'll keep reading it now for as long as you folks keep it going. Fascinating and tantalizing, great work.
